scripts.preflight: bun run --filter './orchestrator' check && bun run --filter './orchestrator' test && bun run --filter './web' check
scripts.preflight:quick: bun run --filter './orchestrator' check && bun run --filter './web' check
scripts.check: bun run --filter './orchestrator' check && bun run --filter './web' check
scripts.helm:install:dev: helm install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-dev --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/development.yaml
scripts.helm:install:staging: helm install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-staging --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/staging.yaml
scripts.helm:install:prod: helm install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-prod --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/production.yaml
scripts.helm:upgrade:dev: helm upgrade --install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-dev --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/development.yaml
scripts.helm:upgrade:staging: helm upgrade --install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-staging --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/staging.yaml
scripts.helm:upgrade:prod: helm upgrade --install mastragen helm/mastragen -n mastragen-prod --create-namespace -f helm/mastragen/values/production.yaml
scripts.minikube:deploy: bun run minikube:build && bun run helm:upgrade:dev && kubectl rollout restart deployment/mastragen-orchestrator -n mastragen-dev || true
scripts.minikube:deploy:quick: bun run minikube:build:orchestrator && bun run helm:upgrade:dev && kubectl rollout restart deployment/mastragen-orchestrator -n mastragen-dev || true
